services.name: Oahu fishing
services.desc: All necessary fishing gear will be provided for you on our sportfishing charters. A briefing of our safety equipment and how to reel in your fish will get you ready for the fishing charter. Oahu offers some of the best offshore sportfishing grounds to catch sportfish such as Pacific Blue Marlin, Mahi Mahi (dorado), Ahi (yellowfin tuna), Ono (wahoo), and Aku (skipjack tuna). Private full day sportfishing charters depart at 6:00 am from Kewalo Basin Harbor. We will be out fishing for 8 to 9 hours. Capacity: Includes up to 6 passengers Daily private half day sportfishing charters depart at 6:00 am or 12:30 pm from Kewalo Basin Harbor. We will be out for 4 to 5 hours. Capacity: Includes up to 6

services.name: Whale Watching Excursions
services.desc: Whale watching tours depart daily. This is one of the best activities in Oahu. The whales visit Oahu between December and May. Join us today for a two hour trip to see magnificent whales, dolphins, and turtles in there natural environment. The staff is experienced and will do there best to get you close to these

services.name: Honolulu Sunset Cruise
services.desc: After an amazing day of sport fishing in Honolulu nothing beats our nightly private Honolulu sunset cruise. During this two hour sunset cruise you can invite up to six guests and take in the incredible view. Most importantly, Relax, talk story and BYOB as the ice chests are waiting aboard our 35ft charter boat the Sashimi. Take in the famous Waikiki city lights from sea a view few visitors to Honolulu experience. Certainly you’ll find our price on a private sunset cruise in Honolulu the best value in town! Experience the Aloha spirit on our sunset charters in Honolulu. All of our charters are family friendly and consequently our sunset cruise is one of best times to reminisce with friends.
